title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 25
text:
Location Deductibles
• We can apply deductibles to a location (site deductible) or on a unit of 
coverage at a location (location coverage specific).
• There may be specific deductibles for selected regions locations.
• In the loc file, filter for specific regions described in the slip (e.g. by state, 
occupancies or location name).
• You may need to filter the loc file on specific criteria e.g. State, occupancy.
• It is often useful to create columns USERTXT1 and USERTXT2. They values in 
these column are free for you to alter as you please to categorise criteria e.g. 
member names or location types. They will be maintained on import into 
RiskLink but will not affect any modelling outcome.
